svg.title: An idealized ocean wave
svg.desc: A sinusoidal water wave with two crests and two troughs moves right at speed vw. A dashed line marks the undisturbed water level. Crests rise a height X above it and troughs dip X below it, labeled −X, so a sea gull floating in a trough sits 2X below where it was on the crest; its earlier position is shown faded above. The wavelength λ is the distance between adjacent crests.
